subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen official third-party GitHub Action revisions for workflows that handle app tokens, OpenAI keys, release credentials, registry credentials, provenance, and security scanning?
rationale: The diff is a routine Dependabot update, but accepting a changed immutable action revision is a repository supplier-trust decision that source-level review cannot make on behalf of the credential and release-workflow owner.

options.title: Verify and merge the supplier update
options.body: Confirm the official upstream provenance and release changes for the secret-capable actions, then merge after required workflow checks pass.

options.title: Defer the grouped update
options.body: Pause this PR if the CI/security owner cannot yet approve the new action revisions, keeping the existing immutable pins until a reviewed update is ready.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge the supplier update
recommendation.body: Confirm the official upstream provenance and release changes for the secret-capable actions, then merge after required workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner can evaluate the credential, release, provenance, and automation trust boundaries affected by the action pins.
